paths.path_name: TypeScript projects must upgrade @types/react and @types/react-dom with Next.js 14

conditions.statement: The upgrade moves the application to Next.js version 14.

evidence.quote_or_summary: To update to Next.js version 14, run the following command using your preferred package manager
evidence.relevance: The type-package upgrade note applies to the 13 -> 14 upgrade procedure.
evidence.quote: To update to Next.js version 14, run the following command using your preferred package manager

conditions.statement: The application uses TypeScript.

evidence.quote_or_summary: If you are using TypeScript, ensure you also upgrade @types/react and @types/react-dom
evidence.relevance: The guidance only applies to TypeScript projects.
evidence.quote: If you are using TypeScript, ensure you also upgrade @types/react and @types/react-dom

conditions.statement: The application depends on @types/react or @types/react-dom at a version that is not the latest.

evidence.quote_or_summary: ensure you also upgrade @types/react and @types/react-dom to their latest versions
evidence.relevance: Outdated React type packages are the thing the guide says must be upgraded.
evidence.quote: ensure you also upgrade @types/react and @types/react-dom to their latest versions

ambiguities: The text does not state which minimum @types versions are required or what errors occur if they are not upgraded.

suggested_actions: Upgrade @types/react and @types/react-dom to their latest versions alongside next, react, react-dom and eslint-config-next (e.g. npm i @types/react@latest @types/react-dom@latest).
Run a TypeScript type check after upgrading to confirm there are no type errors.

paths.description: Next.js 14 requires Node.js >=18.17.0 (raised from 16.14). Deployments or build environments running an older Node.js version will not be supported.

conditions.statement: The upgrade crosses Next.js release 14, where the minimum Node.js version was raised.

evidence.quote_or_summary: The minimum Node.js version has been bumped from 16.14 to 18.17
evidence.relevance: Ties the Node.js requirement change to the v14 upgrade.
evidence.quote: The minimum Node.js version has been bumped from 16.14 to 18.17

conditions.statement: The application's build or runtime environment uses a Node.js version lower than 18.17.0.

evidence.quote_or_summary: The minimum Node.js version has been bumped from 16.14 to 18.17, since 16.x has reached end-of-life.
evidence.relevance: Environments below the new minimum are unsupported by Next.js 14.
evidence.quote: The minimum Node.js version has been bumped from 16.14 to 18.17, since 16.x has reached end-of-life.

suggested_actions: Upgrade Node.js to version 18.17.0 or later in all build, CI and runtime environments (Dockerfiles, CI configs, .nvmrc, engines field).
Update package.json engines.node to ">=18.17.0".

paths.description: The `next export` CLI command was removed in Next.js 14. Build scripts or deployment pipelines that run `next export` will break after upgrading. The replacement is the `output: 'export'` setting in the Next.js config.

conditions.statement: The upgrade crosses Next.js release 14, where the next export command was removed.

evidence.quote_or_summary: The next export command has been removed in favor of output: 'export' config.
evidence.relevance: The removal is introduced in v14.
evidence.quote: The next export command has been removed in favor of output: 'export' config.

conditions.statement: The project's scripts, CI or deployment pipeline invokes the `next export` command.

evidence.quote_or_summary: The next export command has been removed
evidence.relevance: Any invocation of the removed command will fail after the upgrade.
evidence.quote: The next export command has been removed

conditions.statement: The project already uses `output: 'export'` in the Next.js config instead of `next export`.

evidence.quote_or_summary: in favor of output: 'export' config
evidence.relevance: Projects already on the replacement config are not affected, provided they do not also invoke `next export`.
evidence.quote: in favor of output: 'export' config

ambiguities: The text does not say whether the behavior of output: 'export' differs from next export; it defers to the docs.

suggested_actions: Remove `next export` from package.json scripts and CI/deployment pipelines.
Set `output: 'export'` in next.config.js and use `next build` to produce the static export.
Consult the Next.js static export docs for details.

paths.path_name: ImageResponse import from next/server renamed to next/og
paths.description: In Next.js 14, the ImageResponse import was moved from next/server to next/og. Code importing ImageResponse from next/server must be updated; a codemod is available.

conditions.statement: The upgrade crosses Next.js release 14, where the ImageResponse import was renamed from next/server to next/og.

evidence.quote_or_summary: The next/server import for ImageResponse was renamed to next/og.
evidence.relevance: The rename is part of the v14 summary of changes.
evidence.quote: The next/server import for ImageResponse was renamed to next/og.

conditions.statement: The application imports ImageResponse from next/server.

evidence.quote_or_summary: The next/server import for ImageResponse was renamed to next/og.
evidence.relevance: Only code importing ImageResponse from next/server is affected by the rename.
evidence.quote: The next/server import for ImageResponse was renamed to next/og.

ambiguities: The text does not state whether the old next/server import fails outright or still works with a deprecation warning in 14.

suggested_actions: Change imports of ImageResponse from 'next/server' to 'next/og'.
Run the official Next.js codemod to automatically rename the ImageResponse imports.

paths.path_name: @next/font package removed in favor of built-in next/font
paths.description: In Next.js 14 the @next/font package has been fully removed. Applications importing from @next/font must switch their imports to the built-in next/font (a codemod is available).

conditions.statement: The upgrade crosses Next.js release 14, where @next/font was fully removed.

evidence.quote_or_summary: The @next/font package has been fully removed in favor of the built-in next/font.
evidence.relevance: The removal takes effect in v14, so an upgrade from 12 to 14 crosses it.
evidence.quote: The @next/font package has been fully removed in favor of the built-in next/font.

conditions.statement: The application imports from or depends on the @next/font package.

evidence.quote_or_summary: The @next/font package has been fully removed in favor of the built-in next/font.
evidence.relevance: Only apps that use @next/font are affected by its removal.
evidence.quote: The @next/font package has been fully removed in favor of the built-in next/font.

suggested_actions: Run the official Next.js codemod to rename @next/font imports to next/font.
Replace imports from '@next/font/...' with 'next/font/...' and remove @next/font from package.json dependencies.

paths.description: Next.js 14 removes the WASM target for next-swc. Environments that relied on the WASM build of the SWC compiler (e.g. platforms without a native next-swc binary) will no longer have that fallback.

conditions.statement: The upgrade crosses Next.js release 14, where the next-swc WASM target was removed

evidence.quote_or_summary: The WASM target for next-swc has been removed.
evidence.relevance: The removal is listed in the v14 summary.
evidence.quote: The WASM target for next-swc has been removed.

conditions.statement: The application or build environment uses the WASM target for next-swc

evidence.quote_or_summary: The WASM target for next-swc has been removed.
evidence.relevance: Only builds relying on the WASM build of next-swc are affected.
evidence.quote: The WASM target for next-swc has been removed.

ambiguities: The text does not name the specific package names (e.g. @next/swc-wasm-nodejs) or which platforms used the WASM target, nor does it name a replacement.

suggested_actions: Check whether your build environment relies on the WASM build of next-swc (e.g. @next/swc-wasm-* packages) and ensure a native next-swc binary is available for your platform before upgrading to Next.js 14.
